note: Illinois DNR park on the west shore of Lake Shelbyville near Windsor. Six wooded electric loops; none is on the water (the nearest sites, 260-266, sit about 75 m inside the woods above the beach). The equestrian campground is separate, 1.8 km north. Showers are open about May 1 to November 1. --Claude
